# Sovereign Enterprise

> A company's whole operational layer — tasks, chat, CRM, documents, double-entry books, a transparency-log vault and the people
> directory — running on the employees' own devices, peer to peer. Every write is Ed25519-signed by the device that made it and
> checked by a verify-before-parse gate before it is read. The company state is a pure function of the set of signed writes, so
> devices converge regardless of delivery order. No per-seat software; nothing leaves the building.

Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/sovereign-enterprise/
White paper: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/sovereign-enterprise/whitepaper.html
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/sovereign-enterprise

## The white paper — the AI-native office
- AI runs 90% of a modelled 50-person UK office's operational work on owned machines (an office hub plus two AI boxes);
  five AI-native people oversee it.
- Five-year cost: £12.6m today, £12.7m with an AI seat on every desk, £2.3m AI-native and owned — £10.3m saved (82%).
- Every figure is computed by a tested kernel (src/office.mjs) from sourced UK data (data/basis.json: ONS, gov.uk, DESNZ,
  vendor price pages, LMSYS throughput).

## Proof
- 76 tests; a byte-reproducible hostile-network simulation (16 devices, partitions, 90 attacks, converged);
  a mutation + fuzz witness over every decision kernel.
